name: vaporview-fsdb
description: FSDB-native waveform viewer and RTL debugger for VS Code. A fork of VaporView (GPL-3.0), not affiliated with upstream.

waveform.description: The waveform (file path or URI) to debug; default: the active VaporView FSDB viewer.

clock.description: The clock's dump path, e.g. top.clk; default: chosen automatically (clk, clock, clk_i, ...).

instance.description: The instance whose signals Locals shows at start, e.g. top.u0.

lineBreakpointInstances.description: Line breakpoints watch the line in this instance of its module, or in any instance.

viewsWelcome.contents: Open an FSDB, WCZ, VCD, FST or GHW file to view the netlist.

colors.description: Driver highlight: the bar of the line driving the selected signal now.
Driver highlight: the bar of every other line that assigns the selected signal.
Driver highlight: the faint background of the line driving the selected signal now.
Driver highlight: the note after the driving line (drives <signal> at <time>).

vaporview.enableInstancePathTerminalLink.description: Enable terminal links for instance paths - This may conflict with other extensions that use terminal links for instance paths

vaporview.scrollingMode.description: Scrolling mode for the waveform viewer. Options: 'mouse' (default), 'touch'.

vaporview.touchpadPinchSensitivity.description: Touchpad pinch zoom sensitivity - Higher values Zoom faster.

vaporview.sortNetlist.description: Alphabetically sort scopes, parameters, and variables in the netlist view

vaporview.removeGlitchTransitions.description: Remove glitch transitions (multiple value changes in a single time step) in the waveform viewer. Files must be reloaded for this setting to take effect.

vaporview.defaultTimeUnit.description: When opeining a new wavefom dump file, users can specify a default time unit to convert to.

vaporview.defaultAutoReload.description: Recommended: false (unchecked) - default state for the 'Auto Reload' checkbox in the control bar. When enabled, files opened will have auto reload enabled by default.

vaporview.fstMaxStaticLoadSize.description: Maximum file size (in MB) to load FST files into memory. This is faster, but consumes more memory. Set to 0 to disable.

vaporview.promptLoadSettings.description: When opening a waveform dump file, if a .json file with the same name is found in the same directory, should the viewer load the session from that file?

vaporview.fsdbAddonPath.description: Upstream VaporView's own FSDB reader addon, built by you against the reader libraries from your own installation. Leave empty to read FSDB files with wisp-helper (vaporview.wispHelperPath), which needs no vendor library. Instructions: https://github.com/Lramseyer/vaporview/blob/main/GETTING_STARTED.md

vaporview.fsdbReaderLibsPath.description: Path to find FSDB reader shared libraries (e.g. libnffr.so, libnsys.so for Linux) for your platform. Only for the optional upstream reader path; VaporView FSDB reads FSDB without it. Example: <your installation>/share/FsdbReader/linux64

vaporview.wispHelperPath.$comment: machine: a workspace must not choose an executable to run
vaporview.wispHelperPath.description: Path to wisp-helper, the FSDB / WCZ reader. Empty: the one packaged with the extension, else wisp-helper on PATH.

vaporview.wisp.windowing.$comment: machine: viewer load strategy for this machine (memory), not a property of the dump
vaporview.wisp.windowing.description: Load FSDB / WCZ signals in windows (per-pixel summaries, prefetch); small signals still load whole. Off: every signal loads whole.

vaporview.wisp.workers.$comment: machine: CPU use of this machine, not a property of the dump
vaporview.wisp.workers.description: wisp-helper reader threads (--workers, 1-8). 0: the helper's default (4, or WISP_WORKERS).

vaporview.wisp.cacheMb.$comment: machine: memory of this machine, not a property of the dump
vaporview.wisp.cacheMb.description: wisp-helper decoded-block cache in MiB (--cache-mb). 0: the helper's default.

vaporview.wisp.remoteMode.$comment: machine: depends on the link to this machine, not on the dump
vaporview.wisp.remoteMode.description: Windowed loading tuned for a remote link (fewer round trips, small background whole-loads). auto: on when VS Code runs the extension remotely (Remote-SSH, containers, WSL).

vaporview.wisp.simulatedLink.description: Internal: used by tests. "<rtt ms>,<MB/s>" delays the waveform relay like a remote link. Empty: off.

vaporview.wisp.portLinks.description: FSDB: link port copies to their drivers. Off: port copies are listed without values.

enumDescriptions: Not stated: port copies the converter cannot link stay listed without values.
The run wrote no design signal from outside the logic (no force, deposit or C-code write): the helper computes those port copies from the dump's own description of the logic.
vaporview.wisp.outsideWrites.description: FSDB: whether the simulation wrote any design signal from outside the logic. "none" lets port copies without stored values be computed (reopen the file to apply).

vaporview.wisp.forceLog.$comment: machine: writes a log file on this machine
vaporview.wisp.forceLog.description: FSDB: the simulator's force log (WISP_FORCE_LOG), so forced port copies are detected.

vaporview.wisp.verifyStart.$comment: machine: when this machine spends CPU on the check, not a property of the dump
vaporview.wisp.verifyStart.markdownDescription: When wisp-helper's background whole-file check of a lazily opened FSDB file starts (`WISP_VERIFY_START`). `idle:<seconds>` (default `idle:30`): once no request has been made for that long, so the check does not slow the first reads. `open`: at the open. `request` or `off`: never on its own. Values shown before the check passes are marked unverified either way.

vaporview.wisp.planBudgetMB.$comment: machine: memory of this machine, not a property of the dump
vaporview.wisp.planBudgetMB.markdownDescription: Memory budget in MiB for wisp-helper's FSDB read plan (`RUN_PLAN_BUDGET_MB`). A file whose plan needs more is refused at open with a message naming this setting. `auto`: 40% of the RAM of the machine running the helper, at least 4096 and at most 32768; the memory for computed signals (`outsideWrites` none) is then at most 8 GB, so on very large dumps they show "no value" quickly instead of a long first read (set a number to allow more). A number: that budget (64 to 32768). `off`: the helper's default (max(1 GiB, file size / 2)). Takes effect for files opened after the change.

vaporview.wisp.checkThreads.$comment: machine: CPU use of this machine, not a property of the dump
vaporview.wisp.checkThreads.description: Threads for wisp-helper's whole-file check of an FSDB file, which runs in the background after a lazy open (WISP_VERIFY_THREADS). 0: the helper's default (every CPU it may use, at most 16). Values shown before the check passes are marked unverified either way.

enumDescriptions: Values come at once; the whole-file check runs in the background. If it fails, what is shown stays and an error says the file is corrupted.
The whole-file check runs before the first value (slower open, nothing shown from a file that is refused).
vaporview.wisp.directOpen.$comment: machine: memory/CPU trade-off of this machine at open

vaporview.wisp.env.$comment: machine: a workspace must not set the helper process environment
vaporview.wisp.env.description: Extra environment variables for wisp-helper (for example WISP_INDEX_DIR, WISP_VERIFY_THREADS).

vaporview.wcp.enabled.$comment: machine: opens a network port on this machine
vaporview.wcp.enabled.description: Start a Waveform Control Protocol (WCP) server when VaporView FSDB activates. Clients select the waveform with the WCP load command.

vaporview.wcp.port.$comment: machine: a network port on this machine
vaporview.wcp.port.description: TCP port for the startup WCP server. Set to 0 to let the operating system choose an available port.

vaporview.showRulerLines.description: Vertical ruler lines in the waveform viewer.

vaporview.fillMultiBitValues.description: Multi-bit renderer style - If checked, fills the value box with color. If unchecked, only the outline is drawn.

vaporview.multiBitFixedHeight.description: Bit vector renderer style - If checked, multi-bit signals are drawn with a fixed height. If unchecked, short transitions are drawn with a smaller height.

vaporview.defaultSingleBitColor.description: Default waveform color for single bit signals.

vaporview.defaultMultiBitColor.description: Default waveform color for multi bit signals.

vaporview.defaultCustomSignalColor.description: Default waveform color for custom signals.

vaporview.customColor5.description: Fallback color for Color 5, must be a valid color name.

vaporview.customColor6.description: Fallback color for Color 6, must be a valid color name.

vaporview.customColor7.description: Fallback color for Color 7, must be a valid color name.

vaporview.customColor8.description: Fallback color for Color 8, must be a valid color name.

vaporview.enableAnimations.description: Enable animations for the waveform viewer.

vaporview.useGlow.description: Enable glow effect for the waveform viewer. This is aesthetic only and will probably impact performance.

vaporview.overrideDevicePixelRatio.description: Recommended: false (unchecked) - Override the device pixel ratio for the waveform viewer. This can be used to improve performance on high-DPI displays, or correct for incorrect device pixel ratio detection.

vaporview.userPixelRatio.description: Device pixel ratio for the waveform viewer. This is only used if 'Override Device Pixel Ratio' is enabled.

vaporview.disableAnalogRendererOptimizat.description: Recommended: false (unchecked) - Disable optimizations for the analog renderer. This may reduce rendering performance.

vaporview.trace.designArgs.markdownDescription: Driver tracing (Trace Driver, Trace to Root): the slang arguments of the design the waveform was simulated from, e.g. `["-f", "files.f", "--top", "tb"]`, relative to `#vaporview.trace.designRoot#`. Empty: the `build` of the folder's `.slang/local/server.json` or `.slang/server.json`.

vaporview.trace.designRoot.description: Driver tracing: the folder the design arguments are relative to (empty: the workspace folder holding the waveform).

vaporview.trace.xprop.description: Driver tracing: X-propagation (VCS -xprop) when re-executing a statement. auto: re-run a step merged when the dump agrees with that and not with the x-optimistic run.

vaporview.trace.driverHighlight.description: Driver highlight: while a signal is selected (its waveform row, or the cursor on its name in the editor), mark every source line that assigns it, and the statement driving it at the marker more strongly ("drives <signal> at <time>"). Needs the design model; with no design chosen it shows nothing.

enumDescriptions: When a waveform opens and its design is already chosen, load the design for Trace in the background (the status bar says "Preparing Trace"), so the first Trace does not wait for it.
Load the design only when you first trace: opening a waveform costs nothing extra.
vaporview.trace.prepare.description: Driver tracing: when the design model is loaded.

vaporview.trace.xChainSteps.description: Trace to Root: steps at most before the chain stops (its label says budget).

vaporview.trace.verdiHome.description: Path to your Verdi installation, for the optional cross-check (its bin/ is put first on PATH). Empty: verdi on PATH, else VERDI_HOME.

enumDescriptions: The slang extension's language server when it is installed, else our own slang-server
vaporview.sourceLink.slangConnection.description: How the SystemVerilog editor <-> waveform link reaches slang-server.

vaporview.sourceLink.slangServerPath.description: slang-server executable for the link's own connection (used when the slang extension is not installed). Empty: slang-server on PATH.

vaporview.sourceLink.pathMapping.description: Waveform path mapping rules, each "design prefix = waveform prefix" (e.g. "cpu = top_tb.dut"). Rules inferred from the hierarchies are added separately and never replace these.

vaporview.sourceLink.autoPickProfile.description: When a waveform opens and slang-server has no design yet, build it from the slang profile (.f build file in .slang/, ~/.config/cmux-slang/<project> or the workspace) whose --top matches the waveform's top scope. A notice offers Undo.

vaporview.sourceLink.elaborate.description: When slang-server has no top level, offer to elaborate the design with the module the waveform's top scope is named after.

enumDescriptions: Only on the cursor's line and the selected lines.
On every line that has a signal.
vaporview.sourceLink.inlineValues.description: Show waveform values at the marker after the lines of SystemVerilog editors (outside a waveform debug session, which shows its own).

vaporview.sourceLink.enumNames.description: Rows of enum-typed signals show member names (types from slang-server) by default.

enumDescriptions: Values only on the line the debugger is stopped at.
Values after every visible line of the module's instance.
No values in the editor (Locals and the waveform still show them).
vaporview.debug.inlineValues.description: Debug mode: where SystemVerilog editors show signal values at the marker, as quiet text after the line.

vaporview.sourceLink.hasHistory && (activeCustomEditorId == 'vaporview.waveformViewer' || resourceExtname =~ /^\.(sv|svh|v|vh|svi|svp)$/ || editorLangId == systemverilog || editorLangId == verilog)

editor/context.when: (resourceExtname =~ /^\.(sv|svh|v|vh|svi|svp)$/ || editorLangId == systemverilog || editorLangId == verilog) && vaporview.activated && vaporview.slangTarget == topLevel
(resourceExtname =~ /^\.(sv|svh|v|vh|svi|svp)$/ || editorLangId == systemverilog || editorLangId == verilog) && vaporview.activated && vaporview.slangTarget == buildFile
